designed_relationships: class A SKUs with promotions show censoring during stockouts: observed sales fall below the published latent demand on stockout days (a lost_sale row records the gap); stockout days of the class A promoted pairs at lost-sale locations: {"prod-001": 5, "prod-002": 74, "prod-004": 10, "prod-005": 82, "prod-007": 27, "prod-008": 49} (synthetic).

supplier sup-03 is late on about 30 % of receipts (31.9% of 254), against sup-01 17.1%, sup-02 13.5%, sup-04 15.8% (late = received after the promised date counted on the supplier calendar; synthetic).

location loc-02 is capacity-bound: storage_capacity is 62% of the summed target positions, so orders are cut to the room left (609 reviews blocked; on hand + on order was at least 90 % of capacity on 548 of 548 days vs 0 at loc-01 and 0 at loc-03; peak on-hand 65% of capacity vs 38% and 38%; synthetic).

injections.description: 3 exact replays of already posted movement ids (2 sales, 1 receipt) appended at the end of inventory_movements.
injections.expected_handling: ingest rejects each replay with DUPLICATE_MOVEMENT_ID and keeps the first occurrence; on hand is unchanged.

injections.description: receipt rcpt-01309 is dated 2026-09-12T08:00:00Z, ten days before its order po-0998 (2026-09-22T09:00:00Z); no movement was posted.
injections.expected_handling: ingest rejects it with RECEIPT_BEFORE_ORDER; the line stays open and on order.

injections.description: 2 sup-03 purchase orders are status closed although a line was only partly received (about 65 % of the ordered quantity, the remainder never arrived).
injections.expected_handling: the line stays open (ordered - received > 0) and is listed in partially_received_open_lines; the status flag does not complete it.

injections.description: sup-02 (calendar cal-02) is closed 2026-01-05 .. 2026-01-18; 8 receipts of orders placed before the closure arrive after it, so their calendar lead time spans the closure.
injections.expected_handling: the promised date counts only open days, so a receipt on the extended date is on time; counting calendar days would call it late.

injections.description: 12 intermittent SKUs sell on only about 5-10 % of days, so most rolling-origin folds have zero actual demand.
injections.expected_handling: WAPE is null on a fold whose actuals sum to 0; the zero-demand folds are disclosed.

injections.description: one unit-cost step: +6% on every sup-04 product effective 2026-02-01, inside any valuation period that spans it (for example 2026-01-01 .. 2026-03-31).
injections.expected_handling: each day is valued at the cost in force that day; PO line costs carry the cost at order.

injections.description: 6 open reservations of 25 % of closing stock; a naive position would subtract them twice (once in available, once in the position).
injections.expected_handling: position = on hand + on order - backorders; reserved only reduces available.

injections.description: a movement id re-posted with a different quantity.
an arrival before the order date and an arrival before the quoted lead time (replay).
two policies with different seeds are compared (attempt).
injections.expected_handling: POLICY_SEED_MISMATCH: common random numbers need one seed.

injections.description: pack rounding applied before the minimum order quantity gives an order below MOQ.
injections.expected_handling: MOQ first, then pack rounding: max(raw, MOQ) rounded up to a whole pack.
